description: Small synthetic corpus covering semantic, exact-term, and multi-source retrieval.

chunks.text: The Atlas service stores relational application data in PostgreSQL. Redis is reserved for ephemeral caching and rate limits.
Uploaded knowledge documents are indexed with pgvector cosine search. Retrieval results retain document and chunk provenance.
Error code ZX-204 means an invitation link has expired. Create a new invitation instead of retrying the old link.
When Redis is unavailable, cache reads fail open and the application continues using the primary database.
Access tokens expire after fifteen minutes. Refresh tokens rotate on every successful refresh request.
Project mutations require owner or administrator authority. Read access alone never grants permission to update a project.
Chat messages are retained for thirty days by default. A scheduled cleanup removes expired messages.
Audit events are retained for one year and are not removed by the chat cleanup job.

queries.query: Which database stores relational application data?
How long do access tokens remain valid?
What happens to cache reads when Redis is unavailable?
How long are chat messages and audit events retained?
